questions.q: James says to be hearers of the word and also what?
questions.evidence: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves

questions.q: Faith apart from what, James says, is dead?
questions.evidence: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead
answerTerms: faith apart from works is dead

questions.q: Which little member does James compare to a small fire?
questions.evidence: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest

questions.q: Which prophet does James say prayed earnestly about the rain?
questions.evidence: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months
